protocols.description: Protocols to enable. For LMTP server, this should include 'lmtp' (others like 'imap', 'pop3' not needed unless combined service).

lmtp_rcpt_check.description: Whether to perform recipient address verification before accepting the mail. Set to 'no' for relaxed delivery.

lmtp_auth_required.description: Require authentication before accepting LMTP delivery. Enable if LMTP receives mail from untrusted sources (e.g., internet).

lmtp_connection_limit.description: Maximum number of concurrent LMTP connections per source IP address.

lmtp_recipient_limit.description: Maximum number of recipients allowed per LMTP transaction. Prevents abuse.

lmtp_connect_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for connecting to the LMTP server.

mail_location.description: Mail storage format and location (e.g., 'maildir:~/Maildir' or 'mbox:~/mbox').

lmtp_unix_mode.description: Unix socket file permissions for the LMTP listener (e.g., '0666' for world-writable, '0660' for group-only).

lmtp_unix_user.description: Unix user owning the LMTP socket. Typically 'postfix' if integrated with Postfix.

lmtp_unix_group.description: Unix group owning the LMTP socket.

lmtp_tcp_enabled.description: Enable LMTP over TCP (in addition to Unix socket). Usually not needed if using Postfix integration via Unix socket.

lmtp_tcp_address.description: IP address to bind the TCP LMTP listener. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces (not recommended without TLS/auth).

lmtp_tcp_port.description: Port for LMTP TCP listener. Standard LMTP port is 24.

log_path.description: Path to the main error log file.

info_log_path.description: Path to the info-level log file (less verbose errors).

mail_plugins.description: List of mail plugins to load for LMTP. Common: ['sieve'] for filtering, ['zlib'] for compression.

auth_mechanisms.description: Supported authentication mechanisms (used when lmtp_auth_required = true).

passdb_driver.description: Passdb backend (e.g., 'pam', 'shadow', 'sql', 'ldap'). Only used when lmtp_auth_required = true.

passdb_args.description: Arguments to pass to the passdb driver (e.g., 'scheme=sha512crypt' or 'driver=sql' with config file).

userdb_driver.description: Userdb backend (e.g., 'static', 'sql', 'ldap', 'passwd'). Static is often enough with mail_location using ~ expansion.

userdb_args.description: Arguments for userdb (e.g., static args or SQL query). Used when userdb_driver = static.

mail_fsize_limit.description: Maximum message size (in bytes) accepted by LMTP (0 = unlimited). Set to e.g., 26214400 for 25MB.

mail_max_userip_connections.description: Maximum concurrent LMTP connections per user/IP. Helps prevent DoS.

ssl.description: SSL/TLS behavior for LMTP connections. 'required' forbids non-TLS.

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (if SSL enabled).

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file (if SSL enabled).

postmaster_address.description: Postmaster email address used in error responses and logging.

lda_mailbox_autocreate.description: Automatically create user mailboxes on first LMTP delivery.

lda_mailbox_autosubscribe.description: Automatically subscribe users to new mailboxes.
